The House

The Sole Is The Identity.
The Upper Is The Character.

BUTCI is a luxury footwear house engineered in Italy. Every model is built on one sculptural sole architecture and finished with a distinct upper. Comfort is how a BUTCI wears; precision is how it is engineered; luxury is how it is finished — premium materials and Italian craft in a single object.
